changeSummary: Consolidates current-main platform/security foundations with homepage SSR and the six-theme experience, while introducing canonical ownership, dependency, migration and integration governance. Adds mandatory isolated identity and media policy validation gates without changing Worker routes, UI bundles or D1 schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Every changed repository path resolves to one registered owner
Dependency graph is acyclic and every edge points from consumer to lower-level dependency
Migration ranges are contiguous, non-overlapping and match the actual migration directory
Existing migration files are immutable; new migrations append above the base maximum
Shared surfaces require an ADR in the same PR
API and authorization evidence fingerprints match the exact Worker source
The exact PR head passes architecture, route, source, build and regression checks
Identity and media policy regressions are executed by the mandatory build.
No route, API, UI bundle, media storage binding or migration is introduced by the policy-only slice.
